（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 5 OCT. 1940 / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

III
1/10

With reference to the attached memo. of
Commissioner of Police to D.C. (Special Branch),
enquiries show that CHEN MIAO FAH is a native of
Shanghai, aged 31, residing at 33-E Tsang Ka Zah,
Edinburgh Road, O.O.L. He is an ex-driver employed
by the Johnson Garage, and was dismissed in April,
1935 for being concerned in a strike. For sometime
he obtained a living by teaching driving of motor
cars and in the early part of 1939, he adopted the
name of "Hun Tsoong Motor Car Driving Institute"
(合衆汽車學校 ) with an address at
33-E Tsang Ka Zah, Edinburgh Road, O.O.L. He
later secured employment as a chauffeur in the
Silver Taxi Company, and entrusted his younger
brother CHEN MIAO SUNG (陈妙生) with the task
of managing the institute. CHEN MIAO FAH is the
licensee of motor car No.1424 which is being used
by his brother in teaching driving.

CHEN MIAO FAH and CHEN MIAO SUNG are
cousins of DZUNG KYING FAH (陈金发). The
latter named is a native of Shanghai, aged 24,
residing with his parents at Lane 594, 1 Medhurst
Road. DZUNG was an assistant chauffeur previously
employed by the Cornhill Insurance Company, 18 The
Bund. Shortly after he resigned from the Company
in May, 1940, DZUNG KYING FAH assisted his cousin
CHEN MIAO SUNG in teaching driving. He was

III
10月1日

关于附上的警务处长致特别课副督察长的备忘录，经查询，陈妙发 (CHEN MIAO FAH) 系上海籍，现年31岁，住爱丁堡路 (Edinburgh Road) 老闸捕房辖区 (O.O.L.) 张家宅 (Tsang Ka Zah) 33-E号。他曾是约翰逊汽车行 (Johnson Garage) 雇佣的司机，因参与罢工于1935年4月被解雇。此后一段时间，他以教授汽车驾驶为生，并于1939年初采用“合众汽车学校”之名，地址设在爱丁堡路 (Edinburgh Road) 老闸捕房辖区 (O.O.L.) 张家宅 (Tsang Ka Zah) 33-E号。后来他在银星出租车公司 (Silver Taxi Company) 受雇为司机，并将管理该校的事务委托给其弟陈妙生 (CHEN MIAO SUNG)。陈妙发是车牌号为1424的汽车执照持有人，该车正由其弟用于驾驶教学。

陈妙发与陈妙生系陈金发 (DZUNG KYING FAH) 的堂兄弟。后者陈金发系上海籍，现年24岁，与其父母同住麦赫斯特路 (Medhurst Road) 1号594弄。陈金发此前受雇于外滩18号康希尔保险公司 (Cornhill Insurance Company)，担任助理司机。1940年5月他从该公司辞职后不久，陈金发便协助其堂兄陈妙生教授驾驶。他
